# asyncapi-react

> React component for rendering documentation from your specification in real-time in the browser. It also provides a WebComponent and bundle for Angular and Vue

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/asyncapi/asyncapi-react): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://asyncapi.github.io/asyncapi-react/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
